stance_basis: referenced as a new organization expected to provide realistic pro-recreation viewpoint to the Department of Interior
summary: Outdoor Nation is mentioned by the Trailer Coach Association in their comment letter as a newly formed organization that TCA hopes will provide the Department of Interior with a realistic viewpoint on solving problems related to ORV use and land management. The organization is cited as an attachment (#2) to TCA's letter and is characterized as a counterweight to preservationist groups. No direct statement from Outdoor Nation itself appears in the window.
complaint_summary: The Trailer Coach Association references Outdoor Nation as a prominent new organization they hope will provide the Department of Interior with a realistic viewpoint and approach to solving problems related to ORV use on public lands, positioning it as a pro-recreation counterbalance to preservationist groups.
summary_quote: Among the most prominent of these new organizations is the "Outdoor Nation" (see Attachment #2). We are hopeful that this organization will provide your department with a realistic viewpoint and approach to solving some of the problems to which this statement is addressed.
